description: NOOOOOOO!!! NOT DENNIS!!!
THAT'S MY NAME!!! WHY WOULD YOU STEAL MY NAME?!?!
I'M GOING TO TELL MY MOM!!!
That's my mom's name!
She is super nice! She lets me look at lizards all day!
It's dangerous to go alone!
Take this! It's a lizard!
I hope it helps you on your adventure!
I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
That's what the big robot said to me once.
Goodbye, Dave.
You are named after a turtle?
Turtles are like lizards, right?
Do you paint things?!
My grandpa R.O.B. is an artist robot.
He paints really nice pictures of lizards.
OMG!!! YOU ARE THE FOG WIZARD?!
Can you teach me magic?
I want to summon lizards!
Alice? That's a nice name!
Do you like lizards? I like lizards!
Anges? That's a pretty name!
It sounds like a spell or something!
I want to say it over and over again! Anges! Anges! Anges!
Eve? That's a short name!
Does that mean you are short like my mom? I like short things!
Short things make me happy!
I like that name! It's like a palindrome!
At least that's what my mom says.
I don't really understand what a palindrome is, but it sounds cool!
I know a Peter! He gives me lizards sometimes!
He says that lizards love pepperoni pizza.
Vector is my friend! He is a robot like me!
He likes lizards too!
That's an interesting name. It's kina like a superhero name!
Do you have superpowers? I have super lizard powers!
Greg... interesting name. It sounds like a name for a scientist or something.
Are you a scientist? Do you study lizards?
Do you like to mark things? I like to mark things! I mark my lizards with stickers!
It helps me keep track of them!
How many little lizards do you have?
Clive? That's a really pretty name! You must be really pretty!
Marty? That's a fun name! It sounds like a name for a time traveler or something!
Do you have a time machine? I want to go back in time and see dinosaurs and lizards!
That sounds like a spy's name! Are you a spy....?
Are you spying on me? I hope not! I don't want to get in trouble with my mom!
Do you sing songs? I like to sing songs about lizards!
I have a song about lizards that goes like this: 'Lizards, lizards, they are so cool! I want to be a lizard when I grow up!'
Do you want to hear it? I can sing it for you!
Oh... it's you...
I don't like you, Kevin. You are mean to me.
You stole my lizard once! I don't forgive you for that!
Are you the science guy? I like science! Science is cool!
Do you have any science experiments I can do with my lizards?
I want to do science with my lizards!
Paul? That's a nice name! It sounds like a name for a musician or something!
Do you play any instruments? I like music! I like to play music for my lizards!
Charlie? How's the chocolate factory? I like chocolate! Do you have any chocolate? I can share it with my lizards!
My lizards love chocolate! They eat it all the time! It's their favorite food!
Frank? Do you like hot sauce? I like hot sauce! I put it on my lizards all the time! They love it!
My lizards are really spicy! They are like little fire lizards!
That's a pretty name. Do you like lizards? I like lizards! I have a lot of lizards! They are my best friends!
I hope you like lizards too! We can be lizard friends!
I have a lizard named Luis! He's my best lizard friend!
Hiiii, Muhammad!
Are you the butterfly man?
I think you're the butterfly man.
That's such a really pretty name!!
Hiiiii, Fatima!!
Can you take me to get more lizards?
Do you like pancakes? You remind me of pancakes.
I bet you like pancakes.
OMG!! Hiiiii!!!
Can... can you save me from the monsters?
Hi! Hi! Hi!
HIIII NOAHHHH!!!
Did.. did you know I noah guy?
HIIIII DANNY!
DAAAAAANNNNNNNYYYYYYY!
DO YOU LIKE LIZARDS?!?!
It's you... Jessica!
Hi, Jessica!!!
How many little lizards do you have?
Sarah!! That's such a nice name!
It sounds like the wind! Saraaaaah!
Do you like lizards? The wind loves lizards!
Emmaaaa!! Hi!!
Do you like lizards? I bet you do!
I have a lizard named Emma! She is my prettiest lizard!
Oliver? Like olives?
I don't like olives. But I like lizards!
Do you like lizards more than olives? I hope so.
LUCAAAAS!!
That sounds like a superhero name!!
What's your superpower? Mine is finding lizards really fast!
Mia! That's a tiny name for a tiny person!
I like tiny things! Tiny lizards are the best lizards!
Do you have any tiny lizards?
James? Are you a spy?
I've heard of a spy named James. He likes gadgets.
Do you have any lizard gadgets? I want lizard gadgets.
Ooooh! Sophia is a really fancy name!!
It sounds like you are very wise!!
Can you teach me things? I want to learn more about lizards!!
Henry? That sounds like a king's name!
Are you a king? Can I be the royal lizard keeper?
I would be the BEST royal lizard keeper!!
Grace! That's such a pretty name!
I bet you are really graceful. I am not graceful.
I tripped over my lizard once. It was embarrassing.
Jack? Are you a lumberjack?
Or maybe a flapjack? I like flapjacks.
My lizards like flapjacks too! Well... I think they do.
Lily!! Like the flower!!
I tried to give a lily to a lizard once.
The lizard didn't want it. But it was still a nice gesture.
Sam! I like that name! It's nice and short!
Are you a Sam-I-Am? Do you like green eggs?
Do lizards like green eggs? I should find out!
Victor... that sounds like a name for a villain.
Are you a villain? I hope not.
Even if you are, you can still like lizards. Villains like lizards too.
Claire!! That's such a clear and pretty name!!
Like a clear sky! I like clear skies!
You can see lizards better when the sky is clear!
Ryan! Do you like to run? Ryan sounds like running.
I ran after a lizard once. I didn't catch it.
It was the fastest lizard I ever saw. I respect it.
Zoe!! That's the last letter of the alphabet but it's a GREAT name!!
You must be really special to have a Z name!!
Do you have a Z lizard? A zebra lizard maybe??
Carlos!! Hiii!!
That's a really cool name. It sounds fast.
Are you fast? I need someone fast to help me catch lizards!
Ninaaaaaa!!
That name sounds like a song!!
Nina nina nina!! See? It's a great song!
Tom? Like Tom and Jerry?
I like Jerry better. But I like you too, Tom.
Do you chase lizards? Please don't chase my lizards.
Elena!! That's so elegant!!
It sounds like a name for a princess or a scientist!
Either way you should study lizards!! They are AMAZING!!
MAX!! That's a MAXIMUM name!!
It sounds like you are the MAXIMUM!!
Can you maximally help me find more lizards?!
Rosa! Like a rose!
Roses are nice but lizards are better.
No offense to roses. They are still pretty.
Ben!! Are you big? Big Ben is very big.
I am not very big. But my heart is big.
It's full of lizards. Lizard love.
Lena! That's a smooth name!
It sounds like you slide through life smoothly.
Like a lizard!! Lizards are very smooth and cool!!
George? Are you curious?
I am also curious!! About EVERYTHING!!
Especially lizards. I am very curious about lizards.
Aria!! That's like a song!!
A beautiful song!! Can you sing?
Can you sing a song about lizards? I would love that so much!!
Leon? That sounds like a lion name!
Are you brave like a lion?
I am brave too. Especially when there are lizards involved.
Patricia!! That is a very long and important name!!
You must be very important!!
Important people should definitely look after lizards. Just saying.
Derek... hm.
Derek rhymes with... hmm...
I can't think of anything. But I like your name anyway!
Isla!! Like an island!!
Are you surrounded by water? I like islands!
Island lizards are the coolest lizards!! Do you have island lizards?!
